charts.title: TOI-3493 b: orbits around TOI-3493
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-3493's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-3493 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (2025A&A...697A.169C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CHATURVEDI_ET_AL_2025): P 8.1594667 d

charts.title: TOI-3493 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-3493 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (37, 64, 91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 203377303, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 18-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
